question: In a certain code language, 'CASHEW' is written as 'WEHSAC'. How will 'FLORAL' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'CASHEW' is written as 'WEHSAC',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73a1f29be8f0e76f498b8cec41d2f02028311875a4bc2c4bafe7fff1839bfcc2.png] 

Similarly, for '**FLORAL**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76a2f0e536ae842fa1f2b63662f3047bde17daa1850a33a8e1ae22013dded6b5.png] 

So, 'FLORAL' will be written as '**LAROLF**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
